name: SKINDEEP ARENA: Full-Body Immersion Combat Pod Network
description: Franchise chain of 48-pod immersion arcades spread across Tier 2-3 transit corridors, offering full-body haptic combat simulations from historical battles to corporate warfare scenarios. Each pod seals the user in a gel-suspension harness with BCI uplink and dermally-mapped haptic skin, making every impact, temperature shift, and texture physically real. Known for its aggressive marketing toward off-shift factory workers and chrome-light augmented users who can't afford full neural rigs.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 maintenance worker starts experiencing someone else's memories during their sessions — memories that match a recently disappeared corporate archivist.
A runner is hired to plant a corrupted scenario file into a specific pod before a high-stakes private booking by a corponation security consultant.

An underground circuit of users has discovered that certain pod combinations in the same franchise node allow crude real-time neural communication between users — something the manufacturer claims is impossible.
